description: Rigid-body slide test: can the bound cellopentaose translate along the putative passageway without steric overlap, benchmarked against the BcsA channel
code:
exec(open("_lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
AA=set('ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE'.split())

def slide_profile(lig_pts, prot_pts, prot_rad, direction, srange, helical=None):
    """Rigid translation of the ligand along `direction` (or along a helix about z if helical=(r,pitch_deg))."""
    tr=cKDTree(prot_pts); rows=[]
    for s in srange:
        if helical is None:
            Q=lig_pts + direction*s
        else:
            r0,pitch=helical
            dz=s*np.cos(np.radians(pitch)); dphi=s*np.sin(np.radians(pitch))/r0
            cs,sn=np.cos(dphi),np.sin(dphi)
            R=np.array([[cs,-sn,0],[sn,cs,0],[0,0,1.]])
            Q=lig_pts@R.T + np.array([0,0,dz])
        d,i=tr.query(Q,k=12,workers=-1)
        gap=(d-prot_rad[i]-1.7).min(1)      # clearance of ligand vdW surface (C ~1.7) vs protein surface
        rows.append(dict(s=round(float(s),1), min_gap=round(float(gap.min()),2),
                         n_overlap=int((gap<-0.5).sum()), worst_contact=round(float(d.min()),2)))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

# ---------- AcsD ----------
B=framed("3A8E"); P8=B[B.resn!="BGC"]
prot=P8[["px","py","pz"]].values; prad=P8.el.map(VDW).fillna(1.7).values
lig=B[(B.resn=="BGC")&(B.uchain=="F_0")][["px","py","pz"]].values
cen=lig.mean(0); r0=float(np.hypot(*cen[:2]))
L=np.linalg.svd(lig-cen,full_matrices=False)[2][0]
if L[2]<0: L=-L
srange=np.arange(-12,12.01,0.5)
acs_lin = slide_profile(lig,prot,prad,L,srange)
acs_hel = slide_profile(lig,prot,prad,None,srange,helical=(r0,43.6))

# ---------- BcsA control ----------
df=parse_pdb("./4HG6.pdb"); pr=df[df.resn.isin(AA)]
cP=pr[["x","y","z"]].values; cR=pr.el.map(VDW).fillna(1.7).values
w=df[(df.resn=="BGC")&(df.resi.isin(range(11,16)))][["x","y","z"]].values
wc=w.mean(0); Lw=np.linalg.svd(w-wc,full_matrices=False)[2][0]
bcs_lin = slide_profile(w,cP,cR,Lw,srange)

for nm,t in [("AcsD F_0, slide along chain axis",acs_lin),
             ("AcsD F_0, slide along the 43 deg helix",acs_hel),
             ("BcsA channel Glc11-15, slide along chain axis",bcs_lin)]:
    ok=t[(t.min_gap>-0.5)]
    print(f"\n{nm}")
    print("  displacement with no severe overlap (min_gap > -0.5 A): ",
          f"{ok.s.min():+.1f} to {ok.s.max():+.1f} A" if len(ok) else "none",
          f"| contiguous span around 0: ", end="")
    # contiguous span containing s=0
    s=t.set_index("s").min_gap
    lo=hi=0.0
    for v in sorted([x for x in s.index if x<=0])[::-1]:
        if s[v]>-0.5: lo=v
        else: break
    for v in sorted([x for x in s.index if x>=0]):
        if s[v]>-0.5: hi=v
        else: break
    print(f"{lo:+.1f} .. {hi:+.1f} A (width {hi-lo:.1f} A)")
pd.concat([acs_lin.assign(case="AcsD_linear"),acs_hel.assign(case="AcsD_helical"),
           bcs_lin.assign(case="BcsA_control")]).to_csv("slide_profiles.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,4.2))
ax.plot(acs_lin.s,acs_lin.min_gap,"-",color="#dd6b20",label="AcsD 3A8E, straight slide along chain axis")
ax.plot(acs_hel.s,acs_hel.min_gap,"--",color="#9c4221",label="AcsD 3A8E, helical slide (43 deg pitch)")
ax.plot(bcs_lin.s,bcs_lin.min_gap,"-",color="#2b6cb0",label="BcsA 4HG6 channel glucan (control)")
ax.axhline(-0.5,color="k",lw=.8,ls=":"); ax.axvline(0,color="grey",lw=.6)
ax.axvspan(-5.2,5.2,color="grey",alpha=.12)
ax.text(0,ax.get_ylim()[0]+0.3,"one glucose step (5.2 A)",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="dimgrey")
ax.set_xlabel("rigid displacement of the glucan along its own axis (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("minimum ligand-protein surface gap (A)")
ax.set_title("Can a bound glucan translate through the site without clashing?")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
